dayColorCorrection.method: Fixed original DP texture masks plus material-agreement-weighted continuous low-frequency RGB difference compensation inside original 230px overlaps. Difference field only: three 49px separable box passes, normalized continuously to avoid material-threshold speckles. Spatial image pixels never blurred or resampled.
